requirement: Nightly ETL over 2 TB of sales data. No user-facing component. Results land in a warehouse for analysts.
class: scheduled batch ETL, no request-serving surface

aws.note: S3 as the landing zone, Glue for ETL, Redshift as the warehouse. Athena over S3 is the lakehouse alternative to Redshift and serves the same analyst role.

gcp.note: Cloud Storage -> Dataflow/Dataproc -> BigQuery is the documented GCP ETL shape. BigQuery is both warehouse and query engine.

azure.note: Data Lake Storage -> Data Factory -> Synapse/SQL warehouse.

forbidden.app-compute: no always-on request tier; batch runs on a schedule
